trial_court: Court of learned II Additional Senior Civil Judge, Tenali, Guntur District (HMOP No.98 of 2020)
case_name: Bareddy Sasi Ramya vs Bareddi Venkata Sudhakar Reddy on 26 February 2021
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 2020. They have been living separately due to disputes. The petitioner filed HMOP No.91 of 2020 for dissolution of marriage and also gave complaints against the respondent and others for domestic violence and cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: The balance of convenience lies in favour of the party who would suffer prejudice if the matter is not transferred.
legal_principles.held: Considering the reasons assigned by the petitioner in support of this petition, which are adverted to by Sri N.Siva Reddy, her learned counsel, it is clear that the balance of convenience lies more in favour of the petitioner than the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: A party would not suffer any prejudice if a matter is transferred to another court.
legal_principles.held: He would not suffer any prejudice or difficulty, if the matter from Tenali is transferred to Kakinada in as much as, he is also appearing in other matters in between these places.

outcome.final_order: The request of the petitioner has to be accepted, and this petition has to be allowed.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
